race.comment: A very strong field will contest the Listed Newmarket Handicap over 1200m for 150K. CRIPPS (3) resumed in the Fisher Stakes over 1200m on the straight course there and fought on gamely to finish just over 3 lengths from the winner in ninth place. He has won on this course in the past and should be fighting out the finish. BLAMEITONTHEBOOGIE (6) ended his last prep unbeaten in 3 starts on the Devonport-synthetic course and resumed on a winning note by showing a quick turn of foot to score by a neck at Hobart. He is in the groove, and up to winning this as well. MAGNAPRIME (7) is a very smart gelding when right, and his record is very good. He looked ready to rumble when winning the latest of 2 trials, and on 53kg, he can give this a big shake. GLORY MISSION (12) missed out on a hat-trick of wins when finishing second by half a length here 5 weeks ago. He has trialled nicely in the interim and deserves his chance. MAZZINI (2) is unbeaten in 2 starts fresh up, so don't risk him.
